en: Proverbs 10

p.src: 1  The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
u.src: 1  The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

p.src: 2  Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
u.src: 2  Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

p.src: 3  The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

en: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
u.src: 3  The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

p.src: 4  He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

en: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
u.src: 4  He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

p.src: 5  He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

en: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
u.src: 5  He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

p.src: 6  Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

ja: には祝福があり、 暴力が悪しき者の
en: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
u.src: 6  Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

p.src: 7  The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

en: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
u.src: 7  The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

p.src: 8  The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

en: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
u.src: 8  The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

p.src: 9  He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

en: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
u.src: 9  He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

p.src: 10  One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

en: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
u.src: 10  One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

p.src: 11  The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

en: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
u.src: 11  The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

p.src: 12  Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

en: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
u.src: 12  Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

p.src: 13  Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

en: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
u.src: 13  Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

p.src: 14  Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

en: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
u.src: 14  Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

p.src: 15  The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

ja: を滅ぼすものは、その貧しさである。
en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
u.src: 15  The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

p.src: 16  The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

en: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
u.src: 16  The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

p.src: 17  He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

ja: を歩むが、 叱責を捨てる
en: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
u.src: 17  He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

p.src: 18  He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

ja: があり、 中傷を言い広める
en: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
u.src: 18  He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

p.src: 19  In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

ja: ければ、背きが絶えることはない。 しかし、
en: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
u.src: 19  In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

p.src: 20  The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

en: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
u.src: 20  The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

p.src: 21  The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

en: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
u.src: 21  The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

p.src: 22  The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

en: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
u.src: 22  The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

p.src: 23  It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

ja: うことは愚かな者にとって遊びであり、 知恵は
en: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
u.src: 23  It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

p.src: 24  What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

ja: に降りかかるが、 義
en: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
u.src: 24  What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

p.src: 25  When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

ja: はいなくなるが、 義
en: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
u.src: 25  When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

p.src: 26  As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

ja: 歯に酢、目に煙がそうであるように、
en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
u.src: 26  As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

p.src: 27  The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

en: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
u.src: 27  The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

p.src: 28  The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
u.src: 28  The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

p.src: 29  The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

ja: しい者にとって砦であるが、
en: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
u.src: 29  The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

p.src: 30  The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

en: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
u.src: 30  The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

p.src: 31  The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

en: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
u.src: 31  The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

p.src: 32  The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

ja: ばれるかをわきまえるが、
en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
u.src: 32  The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
